title: skillpack.toml
description: Committed config that makes skillpack re-runs deterministic. Lives at the project root as skillpack.toml.

skill.description: Single-skill form (written by `skillpack init`; backward compatible). Mutually exclusive in practice with the [[skills]] array form.

skills.description: Multi-skill pack form: one entry per skill. Mutually exclusive in practice with [skill].

defaults.description: Persistent user prefs shared across skills.

author.description: Author display name (fallback for skills that omit it).

name.description: Kebab-case plugin/skill name (lowercase letters, digits, single hyphens; no consecutive hyphens, no leading/trailing hyphen).

one_line_description.description: One-sentence task description (leads the SKILL.md description).

when_to_use_phrases.description: Trigger phrases that tell an agent when to reach for this skill.

invocation_command.description: Exact CLI invocation, e.g. `chronicle --new "entry"`. Omit for pure libraries.

import_pattern.description: Import pattern for pure libraries, e.g. `import { parse } from 'fastcsv'`. Omit for CLI projects.

author.description: Author display name (falls back to defaults.author).

license.description: SPDX license id (falls back to defaults.license).

verify_stdin.description: Stdin bytes to feed the CLI during verify spawns (for interactive CLIs that block on stdin).

footguns.description: Project-specific gotchas to document for agents.

allowed_tools.description: Override the language-derived `allowed-tools` frontmatter value (e.g. `Read, Bash`). An empty string suppresses the field.

category.description: Override the language-derived `category` prose (e.g. "the Rust tooling").
